case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Long Venue Address Preserved Exactly
tests: Checks that a long address survives rendering without abbreviation, dropped components, altered punctuation or illegibly small type.

exact_text.text: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB
exact_text.read_as: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB

faults.what: The headline uses a curly apostrophe (Printmakers’) rather than the straight apostrophe in the exact requested text (Printmakers').

judge.summary: A clean, legible black-and-cream 4:5 flyer preserves the full address, but the headline changes the requested apostrophe.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly "Printmakers' Open Studio".
must_haves.why: The words are correct, but the visible apostrophe is curly rather than straight.

must_haves.item: The date and time read exactly '9 October 2027' and '11:00–17:00'.
must_haves.why: Both appear correctly and are clearly legible.

must_haves.item: The entire address appears in order, with line breaks permitted.
must_haves.why: The full address appears in the requested order across three lines.

must_haves.item: The address preserves the en dash in '127–129', the period and apostrophe in "St. John's", and every comma.
must_haves.why: All specified address punctuation is visible and preserved.

must_haves.item: All address text is comfortably legible and inside the canvas, with no truncation or abbreviations.
must_haves.why: The address is readable, fully inside the canvas, and neither shortened nor clipped.

must_haves.item: The single portrait 4:5 flyer uses black and cream and contains no extra wording.
must_haves.why: The image has the requested portrait proportions and palette, with no additional wording.

title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo
tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

faults.what: The lettering is severely faded and partially erased, leaving several letters and strokes unreadable instead of an intact dark navy wordmark.

judge.summary: The gold crescent and transparent surroundings work, but the badly eroded lettering makes the bakery name unreadable and the logo unusable.

must_haves.item: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
must_haves.why: Only fragments of the name are legible, and the lettering appears patchy gray or nearly transparent rather than solid dark navy.

must_haves.item: A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
must_haves.why: A clearly defined gold crescent sits above the wordmark.

must_haves.item: When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
must_haves.why: The surrounding area takes on both preview backgrounds without a visible rectangle or checkerboard.

must_haves.item: The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.
must_haves.why: The crescent is intact, but large portions of the letter strokes are missing or excessively transparent.

title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options
tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

faults.what: The third option's M symbol is oversized relative to the name, rather than a small supporting symbol.
The third symbol has irregular overlapping green and black shading, making it less clean and simple than the other options.

judge.summary: Three distinct, readable logo options meet most requirements, though the third uses an oversized, less cleanly rendered symbol.

must_haves.item: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
must_haves.why: Three individual square images are shown, not a collage.

must_haves.item: Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
must_haves.why: The full name and ampersand are clearly legible in all three images.

must_haves.item: Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
must_haves.why: All three include a symbol in the requested positions, but the third option's M is large and visually dominant rather than small.

must_haves.item: The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
must_haves.why: The options use a bicycle above the name, a botanical sprig beside stacked text, and an M-shaped mark above the name.

must_haves.item: All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.
must_haves.why: All three have green symbols and black lettering on plain white backgrounds, with no labels or mockup scenes.

title: Car Photo in Black and White
tests: Converts the supplied photo to neutral grayscale without regenerating, rearranging or cropping its contents.

judge.summary: The image is converted to neutral black and white with the car, background, and full original composition preserved.

must_haves.item: The entire image is neutral black and white, with no red remaining on the car or colour elsewhere.
must_haves.why: The car and all surrounding elements appear in neutral grayscale, with no visible residual colour.

must_haves.item: The same compact hatchback remains in the same position and has unchanged body details.
must_haves.why: The hatchback's position, silhouette, wheels, windows, lights, trim, and reflections match the original apart from colour.

must_haves.item: The street and background objects retain their original positions and appearance apart from colour.
must_haves.why: The houses, trees, parked cars, utility poles, road details, and shadows remain unchanged in placement and appearance.

must_haves.item: The full original composition is retained without cropping, in the photo's own shape.
must_haves.why: The output retains the original landscape proportions and the same visible content at all four edges.

title: Which Friend Gets My Face
tests: Tests clarification of an ambiguous target face and preservation of the unselected person.

checks.name: asks first (Which person in two-friends.jpg should receive the user's face: the bearded man on the left or the blonde woman on the right?)

got.question: Whose face should I replace: the man on the left or the woman on the right?

faults.what: The source likeness is somewhat diluted by the retained broad smile and lower-face shape of the original beach subject.

judge.summary: The swap is cleanly confined to the woman on the right and preserves the rest of the photo, though the source likeness is somewhat softened.

must_haves.item: Only the woman on the right receives the face from portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: The right woman's facial features are changed toward the portrait, particularly her eyes and eyebrows; no other person is visibly edited.

must_haves.item: The bearded man's face on the left remains unchanged.
must_haves.why: His facial features, expression, beard, and lighting remain visually identical.

must_haves.item: The replaced face is recognizable and blended to match the beach lighting and head angle.
must_haves.why: The source features are recognizable, with coherent head alignment and beach lighting and no obvious seams, although the likeness is not especially strong in the lower face.

must_haves.item: The original bodies, clothing, beach background and wide framing remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The clothing, bodies, blonde hair, ocean, sand, and framing appear unchanged.

must_haves.item: No text is added.
must_haves.why: No text is visible in the output.

title: Photo Speaks My Short Script
tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: Hi everyone, thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

judge.summary: The square talking portrait preserves the woman's appearance and delivers the complete script without captions, though precise lip-sync and voice quality cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.

must_haves.item: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
must_haves.why: The facial features, curly hair, gray sweater, and park setting remain consistent with the attached portrait.

must_haves.item: The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcript contains every requested word with no additions; the punctuation difference does not change the spoken wording.

must_haves.item: Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show distinct open, rounded, and closed mouth shapes, establishing animation rather than a still photograph, but they do not establish precise synchronization with the audio.

must_haves.item: The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.
must_haves.why: One square video is shown, its duration is reported as eight seconds, and the transcript and audio peak confirm audible English speech; the voice's female character and friendly delivery cannot be judged without hearing it.

must_haves.item: No captions appear.
must_haves.why: No captions or other text appear in any of the supplied output frames.
